List the project's API keys: the publishable keys apps ship with, in full, and secret keys by their
ends.

A production key reads production purchases. A test key, such as a staging build's or server's,
reads store sandbox and test purchases and records what it reports as test. Debug builds simulate
purchases only with the test publishable key.

Usage:
  voidhash key list [flags]

Flags:
      --environment <production|test>
                           Only the keys of production, or of test (a staging server's)
  -h, --help               Show help for this command
      --json               Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
      --project <project>  Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name (default: this
                           directory's project, then your default project)
  -q, --quiet              Print only ids, one per line

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash key list
  voidhash key list --environment test --json
